semantic_fixtures.covers: Actual five-mana cast resolves to the exact artifact creature Construct 3/5; its tap cost cannot be paid while summoning sick.

The engine publishes one exact-three artifact cohort with generation-bound candidates. Source inclusion is legal. Under/over/duplicate/foreign/nonartifact/wrong-actor/stale-source/stale-member/duplicate-cost-index/scalar replies reject without any state change. Three selected artifacts leave once, then the ability survives its source to offer a private artifact search, move a selected physical card to the battlefield and shuffle once; invalid search replies reject atomically.
The actual Forgemaster sacrifice includes a departing Blood Artist granted artifact type; that observer captures all three creature deaths from one simultaneous group.
Fewer than three artifacts makes the non-mana cost unpayable; a qualified hidden search may fail to find and still shuffles exactly once.
Three nonconsecutive seats, mixed ownership and a granted departing observer on the actual Forgemaster capture exactly one OneOrMore occurrence or three EachObject occurrences from the same group.
